description.text: V Starter Deck: Infinite Power, released with the second Sword & Shield expansion, Infinite Power: a random 60-card deck, ready to play out of the box, with damage counters and a rule book. The official page singles out the Pikachu V, Crobat V, Eternatus V, Charizard V, Venusaur V and Lucario V the decks could hold, with Trainers such as Boss's Orders and Quick Ball. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
